newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - THREE BRAZILIAN BANKS INITIATED.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - THREE BRAZILIAN BANKS INITIATED.

text.p: HSBC James Capel said it started coverage of Brazilian private banks Banco Itau and Unibanco with a buy rating.
- also said it initiated Brazil's largest private bank Bradesco as a hold.

- said in a report Banco Itau, its top pick, is the most profitable of the three banks it analyzed. - said it expects Itau's return on equity to increase to 18.6 percent and 20.2 percent in 1997 and 1998, respectively, from 16.5 percent in 1996 "through real loan growth of 16 percent this year and 22 percent in 1998; significant advances in fee income; continued efficiency gains and other profitable products."

- also said the acquisition of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banco Banerj SA provides an excellent platform for expanding market share in the southeastern state of Rio de Janeiro and a model for expansion as other state banks are privatized.
- Itau bought Banerj in the first privatization auction of a Brazilian state bank in June.
- Regarding Unibanco, HSBC James Capel said it expects the bank to increase market share in retail lending, insurance and mutual funds and private pensions.
